dedupe_keys.name: icheme safety and loss prevention lessons learned database

description: A collection of one-page summaries of major process industry incidents. The IChemE page says the Safety and Loss Prevention group's lessons learned database gives, for each incident, a one-page summary of causes and lessons with links to the investigation reports, and an index PDF with root-cause infographics. The database is a free downloadable PDF. Coverage is major incidents in the chemical and process industries worldwide. Caveats: it is a curated set, not a complete register, and the licence is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives worked causal chains of real plant accidents, such as loss of utilities or equipment failure leading to fires, explosions and releases, to build and check event trees for industrial failure scenarios. A related catalogue record is the natech lightning process industry events dataset.
